2014_spells.glibness.description: Until the spell ends, when you make a Charisma check, you can replace the number you roll with a 15. Additionally, no matter what you say, magic that would determine if you are telling the truth indicates that you are being truthful.
2014_spells.glibness.effectSummary: Change a target: until the spell ends, when you make a Charisma check, you can replace the number you roll with a 15
2014_spells.glibness.fullDescription: Using 1 action, until the spell ends, when you make a Charisma check, you can replace the number you roll with a 15. Additionally, no matter what you say, magic that would determine if you are telling the truth indicates that you are being truthful. Until the spell ends, when you make a Charisma check, you can replace the number you roll with a 15.
